title: Father of Mercies, in Thy Word
description: Father of Mercies, in Thy Word in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Anne Steele wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 117.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Fa-ther of mer-cies, in Thy Word What end-less glo-ry shines! For-ev-er be Thy name a-dored For these ce-les-tial lines.

lines: Father of mercies, in Thy Word
Oh, may these heavenly pages be
And still new beauties may I see
Teach me to love Thy sacred Word

licence: Public domain: Anne Steele died in 1778.
credits: Words by Anne Steele (1717–1778), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
